text:
Maya (AE): quick thread to lock POC sandbox plan + who owns redaction + hosting tier. Need final by EOD Tue so we can provision. @Diego (SE) @Alex (Solutions) @Pri (Customer IT)
Diego (SE): main questions: do you want us to run redaction on ingest, or will you provide already-redacted sample files? And do you need Dedicated for the trial or is hosted acceptable?
Pri (Customer IT): we can only share anonymized data. We'll produce ~1k rows with full text tickets and ~50 labeled eval cases. We can't send unhashed user ids. Dedicated preferred for regulatory reasons; 1-week pilot is fine.
Alex (Solutions): options: (1) Hosted test project (fastest) with our ingest redactor enabled; (2) Dedicated short-term pool (isolated infra) — requires a refundable hold; (3) Private (VPC) but longer lead time. For speed I'd recommend Hosted + our redaction enabled if policy allows.
Nina (Customer ML): eval targets: want automated scoring on 50 labeled cases + 150 blind prompts. Quality target >=90 F1 on intent labels. Latency target p95 <250ms for single-turn.
Maya (AE): note on pricing: hosted POC covered by credits; Dedicated short pilots need a refundable hold equal to one week of reserved capacity. I'll confirm amounts after internal approval.
Pri (Customer IT): data transfer: pref presigned S3 PUTs. We can do SFTP as fallback. Bucket: s3://nova-poc/uploads/
Diego (SE): presigned flow example (client-side): 
```
curl -X PUT "${PRESIGNED_URL}" -T sample.csv -H "Content-Type: text/csv"
```
Also recommended bucket policy snippet (minimal):
```
{ "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{ "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/ingest"},
    "Action":"s3:PutObject",
    "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::nova-poc/uploads/*"
  }]
}
```
Pri (Customer IT): we need the redaction SLA before any upload. It must state that raw identifiers won't be stored and logs are ephemeral.
Alex (Solutions): we can provide a redaction SLA template. For ingest redaction we produce a CSV report listing redacted fields + hashes. We also support client-side libs if you want to keep full control.
Nina (Customer ML): prompt examples I'll want in eval harness: \u201cWrite a concise summary of the support ticket and list 3 remediation steps\u201d; \u201cClassify ticket urgency: low/med/high\u201d. We'll run the harness locally and push results.
Diego (SE): proposed success criteria: (A) 200 end-to-end generations using sample data; (B) intent classification F1 >=90; (C) p95 latency <250ms; (D) no unhashed user_id in logs; (E) CSV redaction report approved by customer's privacy lead. Agree?
Pri (Customer IT): agree to A-C and E. For D we need retention = 3 days during POC, with export access.
Maya (AE): retention 3 days OK. We'll enable export and provide S3 export zip on demand.
Alex (Solutions): provisioning timeline (business days): Day 0: kickoff + creds; Day 1: SLA sign and data prep; Day 2: ingest + redaction smoke; Day 3: routing + baseline tests; Day 4: eval run; Day 5: wrap & sign-off. Target = 5 BD.
Pri (Customer IT): sounds good. Provide me the SLA + the redaction report format. Also confirm IP ranges to allow in egress (we'll add to firewall).
Diego (SE): our egress CIDR for the test cluster: 52.23.120.0/24, 18.205.33.0/24 (example). We'll send the formal list in the SLA doc.
Maya (AE): next steps: I'll send the refundable hold terms, Diego will share SLA + ingest checklist, Alex will prepare the eval harness (python runner + scoring), and security-bot will set a 30-min call with Pri this week. Target: provision by next Thu. :rocket:
security-bot: scheduled 30m security review with Customer IT for Wed 15:30 UTC — join link will be posted in calendar.
